articles.headline: Caleb Wilson's hand injuries not connected as Bulls rookie deals with 'bad luck'
articles.description: Caleb Wilson has sustained three hand-related injuries in the past year, but the Chicago Bulls rookie said doctors told him they're not connected and that it's a case of "bad luck," he told reporters before his team's game against the Washington Wizards.
